programs.title: Druk
programs.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that humans are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programs.title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
programs.desc: Los Angeles.Peter Bretter is a musician.His compositions can be heard in many television productions.However, the man's real dream is to stage a puppet musical about Count Dracula, who is looking for true love.He has been living in a happy relationship with actress Sarah Marshall for six years.Peter loves the girl completely and doesn't seem to notice her flaws.And Sarah has too many of them.As the star of a popular crime series, he makes himself felt by those around him with his selfishness, lack of respect for the feelings of others and the expectation of constant adoration.One day, Bretter is abandoned by his beloved.Devastated and hurt, he cannot regain his balance for many weeks.Finally, on the advice of his brother Brian, he decides to go on vacation to a resort in Hawaii.There he hopes to recover from unhappy love.Unfortunately, on arrival he is horrified to discover that Sarah and her new partner, rocker Aldous Snow, have rented a room in the same hotel.Meanwhile, a suffering Peter attracts the attention of attractive receptionist Rachel Jansen.The woman decides to help him.

programs.title: Queer
programs.desc: Year 1950, Mexico.William Lee (Daniel Craig), a middle-aged American, spends his days almost alone.He contacts several people from a small American community of students and bar owners.The arrival of another student, Eugene Allerton (Drew Starkey), in town makes him realize for the first time that an intimate bond is possible.The men first become friends, then their relationship turns into a romance.As a couple, they go to South America in search of a drug that supposedly gives the power of telepathy.

programs.title: Bird
programs.desc: 12-year-old Bailey (Nykiya Adams), her brother Hunter (Jason Buda) and her dad Bug (Barry Keoghan) live illegally in an abandoned building.The father doesn't have much time for the children.He is busy preparing for the wedding with his stepmother, whom they dislike, and looking for easy money.The mother became involved with an aggressive partner.Bailey also finds no support among her peers and becomes increasingly alienated.Her love for birds is her salvation.The girl spends more and more time alone in nature.One day she meets a tramp, Bird (Franz Rogowski), who asks her for help... Behind the camera, Andrea Arnold, director of "Fish Tank" and "American Honey" and the documentary "Cow".

programs.title: This Is Benjamin Ingrosso: Part 1
programs.desc: The story of the life of a Swedish singer.He was successful from an early age.She constantly develops her talent, striving to become the biggest pop star in Sweden.
